clusters.title: Adaptive Multi-Agent Systems
clusters.description: I study populations of learning, heuristic, and deliberative agents interacting over evolving economic networks, studying how local adaptation shapes aggregate dynamics.

clusters.title: Statistical Verification
clusters.description: I use convergence diagnostics and statistical model checking to make simulation evidence more reliable and reproducible.

clusters.title: Robust Quantitative Methods
clusters.description: I apply econometrics, robust statistics, and graph learning to systemic risk and financial decision problems.

clusters.title: Text Analytics and Language Models
clusters.description: I apply text analytics and language models to multilingual corpora, sentiment and narrative dynamics, and to systems based on retrieval and embeddings.

nodes.title: RiskSentinel - Agentic Systemic Risk Simulator
nodes.summary: Multi-agent systemic risk simulator for financial contagion analysis on 210 S&P 500 stocks, built for Microsoft AI Dev Days Hackathon 2026 and deployed as an interactive Streamlit app.

nodes.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
nodes.summary: Event-driven multi-agent coordination system for auction-based procurement, inventory allocation, and real-time fulfillment under demand uncertainty.

nodes.title: Real Estate AI Agent
nodes.summary: Autonomous AI agent for property-market analysis, price estimation, and natural-language interaction built on predictive models and LLM orchestration.

nodes.title: Island Model + MultiVeStA — Statistical Model Checking of Economic Growth
nodes.summary: Accepted paper at MARS @ ETAPS 2026. Reproduces and extends Fagiolo & Dosi (2003) Island Model using MultiVeStA for statistical model checking, with formal convergence guarantees on parameter sensitivity analysis.

nodes.title: Robust Portfolio Optimization under Systematic Market Disruptions (PFSE)
nodes.summary: Novel PFSE estimator achieves 25% breakdown point with 32× computational speedup over MCD. Out-of-sample Sharpe 1.87 on S&P 500 (2015–2025), 29% lower drawdown during COVID-19. Submitted to Computational Economics.

nodes.title: Network Topology Analysis for Systemic Risk Prediction
nodes.summary: Financial machine learning project combining dynamic correlation networks, graph neural networks, and trading backtests to detect systemic risk in U.S. equity markets.

nodes.title: Gas Network Risk Forecasting
nodes.summary: Second-place hackathon project for gas leak risk prediction using geospatial-temporal features, synthetic data augmentation, and SHAP-based interpretability.

nodes.title: NLP & Semantic Network Analysis
nodes.summary: Technical implementation of the JADT paper pipeline, integrating multilingual preprocessing, topic modeling, correspondence analysis, semantic spaces, sentiment modules, and network-based validation across methods.

nodes.title: Lightweight Fine-Tuning with PEFT & LoRA
nodes.summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipeline using LoRA to adapt DistilBERT for sentiment analysis while training less than 1% of the model parameters.

nodes.title: Custom Chatbot with RAG
nodes.summary: Retrieval-augmented chatbot that combines semantic search, custom embeddings, and LLM prompting for grounded domain-specific conversations.

nodes.title: Statistical model checking of the Island Model: an established economic agent-based model of endogenous growth
nodes.summary: Presented at MARS @ ETAPS 2026, this paper uses MultiVeStA to give the Island Model a more rigorous and reproducible statistical analysis.

nodes.title: Statistical Model Checking of the Keynes+Schumpeter Model: A Transient Sensitivity Analysis of a Macroeconomic ABM
nodes.summary: arXiv preprint introducing Statistical Model Checking (SMC) via MultiVeStA for transient sensitivity analysis of the Keynes+Schumpeter (K+S) macroeconomic agent-based model.

nodes.title: Towards Agentic Agent-based Models: Feasibility, Performance, and Statistical Model Checking
nodes.summary: arXiv preprint (2607.17948) evaluating LLM-driven agentic agent-based models with Statistical Model Checking via MultiVeStA.

nodes.title: A Multi-Method Validation Framework for Large-Scale Multilingual Text Analytics
nodes.summary: Presented at JADT 2026 and awarded the VADISTAT Prize for young researchers, this paper validates 18 analytical approaches on 1M+ texts to identify method-invariant findings.

nodes.title: Network Topology Analysis and Machine Learning Techniques for Systemic Risk Prediction in U.S. Equity Markets
nodes.summary: Leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and complex network theory to detect early warning signals of systemic risk in financial markets.

nodes.title: Robust Portfolio Optimization Under Systematic Market Disruptions: A Factor-Analytic Approach
nodes.summary: Based on my MSc thesis, this paper is currently in review at Computational Economics and develops a robust framework for portfolio optimization under contamination.
